info.title: Scanova Universal API
info.description: Generate, manage, and analyze QR codes programmatically with Scanova, including QR code management, lead lists, user access, and analytics.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response. If not specified, all fields are returned.

schema.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response. If not specified, all fields are returned. Pass multiple values separated by `,`.

category.description: QR Code Category ID. See [Category List](/api-reference/references/category-list) for full reference. In Try it: 1=Website URL, 9=Custom Page, 10=App Store, 11=Google Map, 13=Document, 14=Wedding, 15=Social Media, 16=Audio, 17=Coupon, 18=Product, 19=Image, 20=Event, 23=App Deep Link, 24=Business Card, 25=Restaurant, 26=Feedback, 27=Real Estate, 28=Link Page, 31=GS1, 44=Restaurant.

info.description: JSON data to create QR code. See [Components Reference](/api-reference/references/components) for detailed structure examples for each category.

qrType.description: QR code type. In Try it: dy=Dynamic (editable after creation), st=Static (fixed content).

patternInfo.description: JSON data to create design QR Code (optional). See [Pattern Info Reference](/api-reference/references/pattern-info) for complete customization options and field values.

customDomain.description: Custom domain ID for the QR code (advanced feature - requires plan quota)

expireOn.description: Expiration date and time for the QR code (advanced feature - requires plan quota)

expireOnText.description: Custom HTML text to display when QR code is expired (advanced feature - requires plan quota)

expireOnTimezone.description: Timezone for expiration date (advanced feature - requires plan quota)

highAccuracyConfirmation.description: Enable high accuracy confirmation for location-based QR codes (advanced feature - requires plan quota)

highAccuracyGeoFencing.description: Enable high accuracy geo-fencing for location-based QR codes (advanced feature - requires plan quota)

highAccuracyGeoFencingConfig.description: Configuration for high accuracy geo-fencing (advanced feature - requires plan quota)

highAccuracyMode.description: Enable high accuracy mode for location-based QR codes (advanced feature - requires plan quota)

highAccuracyModeText.description: Text to display when requesting location access (advanced feature - requires plan quota)

leadList.description: Lead list ID for capturing leads (advanced feature - requires plan quota)

minimumAge.description: Minimum age requirement for accessing QR code content (advanced feature - requires plan quota)

password.description: Password protection for QR code access (advanced feature - requires plan quota)
